name: io.github.xiaobinger/wechatmp-mcp
description: Create 贴图/图文 in the WeChat Official Account console; save or publish. 公众号后台：建贴图/图文，存草稿或发表。

environmentVariables.name: WXMP_PROFILE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory of the persistent Playwright profile that holds the console login. Defaults to ./.state/profile

environmentVariables.name: WXMP_OUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for screenshots (QR code, composer, publish evidence). Defaults to ./out

environmentVariables.name: WXMP_BROWSER_CHANNEL
environmentVariables.description: Installed browser to drive: msedge (default) or chrome. Empty string uses Playwright's bundled chromium, which needs `playwright install chromium`.

environmentVariables.name: WXMP_HEADLESS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to run without a visible window. Not recommended: the QR scan needs the window and the console is friendlier with a human watching.

environmentVariables.name: WXMP_CDP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Attach to an already-running Chrome (for example http://127.0.0.1:9222) instead of launching one.

environmentVariables.name: WXMP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional bearer token required by the Streamable HTTP transport.
